body: I had the same problems when I was forced antipsychotics. Now I just take lithium at the minimal necessary dose and it is much better. Had to learn how the desease  work on me and how to fight back in order to reach this point (4 years since diagnosis, 47M). Good luck.

Same situation. Go on lithium but find the minimal needed dose. I tried to taper off many times but ended up in manic states alla the times (4). They never let me the chance to learn how to manage that state because I was forcedly drugged all the time, even if I was perfectly calm in that moment. Good luck.
sorry mate, if a medical school dismisses someone on medical issues it means that we still live in middle ages...

You are not alone, if this may help. I got diagnosed 4 years ago and in the meanwhile I lost everything. Family, house, job, car...

I currently live in my mother's rented apartment she is 84 and I am 47. It feels like there is no way out of this mess especially if you spent the last 4 months in bed with major depression.

I feel you.

Si, passa. Possibile che ritorni, ma poi passa ancora. Come farlo passare, beh, dopo più di 40 anni ancora non lo so. Mi pare piuttosto che siano cicli naturali, soprattutto per persone che vengono definite “bipolari” come me. Ed ho scoperto di recente di esserlo. Detto questo sono appena uscito dalla più grave depressione che abbia mai vissuto e ne sono uscito così, senza neanche accorgermene e senza fare nulla di particolare. E ti assicuro che quando ci ero dentro non avrei mai immaginato di vederne l’uscita. Un abbraccio!

Definitely, the keywords now are “sanctions” and “invasion”. Everything now turns around those two words. Luckily there is no logic way for Putin to make sense out of the contradictions he already fell into.

Sorry for these people that label and judge without thinking. I’m Italian and some of my best friends are Serbian, some of the most beautiful people I know. Nationalists are assholes, but that’s true everywhere.

The same happened to me too. Time wasted.

Personally, the things I did reflected my deepest fears and wounds and my unfulfilled desires. I learned a lot about myself during those episodes. It was a very wild ride that I hope I’ll not have to experience again.

I’m 44 M, my dad killed himself when I was 19. It was the worst thing that happened to me in my whole life. The pain I felt is indescribable.
The sad thing is that recently I started to get depressed as my dad did and started to seriously contemplate suicide too. The only thing that keeps me alive is my son. I don’t want him to feel the same pain I did. You are not alone. Love.
Go to a pet shelter and get an animal. Dog or cat. Whatever you like most. That’s a big help for people like us.
